levels.surface: أبي عبد الله زكريا بن محمد المؤمن

notes: Editor brackets «[بْنُ]» are an insertion: left out
The Imam «أبي جعفر» is written after «عن» inside the chain, so narrator (owner ruling 2); the saying is his words
«أبي عبد الله زكريا بن محمد المؤمن» is a name led by a kunya: kept as written, not identified
